movie_title: How green is nuclear energy? - 6 Minute English
introduction:
Improve your English vocabulary and listening in just six minutes!
Climate change is reaching emerge

vocabulary.definition: types of natural energy, such as wind and solar power, which can be replaced as quickly as they are used
vocabulary.example: Many countries are investing in renewables to reduce their dependency on fossil fuels.

vocabulary.definition: so strongly held that they are difficult to change
vocabulary.example: Her fear of spiders is so ingrained that even a picture of one makes her anxious.

vocabulary.definition: the feature that makes something different from and better than its competitors
vocabulary.example: The hotel's unique selling point is its stunning rooftop pool with a panoramic view.

vocabulary.definition: a person or thing that suffers as a result of something else happening
vocabulary.example: The increase in pollution is a casualty of the rapid industrial development.

vocabulary.definition: in a gradual manner; slowly over a period of time
vocabulary.example: She gradually learned to speak Spanish by practicing every day.

vocabulary.definition: an awareness or understanding of sensory information
vocabulary.example: Public perceptions of the company changed after the scandal was exposed.
